nodes.description: Library function SafeMath.mul which multiplies two uint256 values with an overflow assertion.
Library function SafeMath.div performing integer division.
Library function SafeMath.sub subtracting b from a with an underflow assertion.
Library function SafeMath.add adding two uint256 values with an overflow assertion.
BasicToken.totalSupply view function returning the stored totalSupply_ value.
BasicToken.transfer moves _value tokens from msg.sender to _to and updates balances.
BasicToken.balanceOf view function returning the balance of _owner.
Mapping(address => uint256) balances tracking token holdings of each account.
uint256 totalSupply_ storing the total token supply.
StandardToken.transferFrom moves tokens using an allowance granted to msg.sender.
StandardToken.approve sets the allowance of _spender for msg.sender.
StandardToken.allowance view function returning the remaining allowance.
StandardToken.increaseApproval increases the allowance of _spender by _addedValue.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval decreases the allowance of _spender by _subtractedValue.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed storing allowances.
GBCToken constructor minting the initial supply to msg.sender.
Public string name of the token, 'GBC Token'.
Public string symbol of the token, 'GBC'.
Public uint decimals, set to 18.
Constant INITIAL_SUPPLY set to 2000000000.
msg.sender used as the source account in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender used as the spender in StandardToken.transferFrom allowances.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in StandardToken.approve.
msg.sender used as the initial supply recipient in the GBCToken constructor.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transfer.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) inside transfer.
balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value) inside transferFrom.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) inside transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] = allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transferFrom.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue).
Branching allowance update in decreaseApproval that zeroes or subtracts from the allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditional allowance overwrite in approve.
Constructor sets totalSupply_ and balances[msg.sender] to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
c = a * b multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
c = a + b addition inside SafeMath.add.
return a - b subtraction inside SafeMath.sub.
